Cancel a running batch job

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    batch_id = "batch-def456"
    result = await client.cancel_batch(batch_id)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
